==='''Overview'''===
'''{{PAGENAME}}''' were introduced in '''[[Update Log#Update 7 - Black Clover Update Part 1|Update 7]]''' alongside the new damage types, and can heavily boost a unit's damage or usability if used correctly.

==Buff Types==
<span class="game-font-face">
* % DMG </span>: Increases the damage of units of that type by a percentage.

* PEN: Penetrates through resistances of enemies. 
**Resistance reduces damage by 100 / (100 + Resistance). So an enemy with 150 Magic Resistance will only take 40% Magic Damage.

* PWR: Increases DPS/Upgrade. Scales with unit level. The amount will change if you equip it to a unit (to reflect the unit level scaling).

==Trivia==    
*You can't equip relics on {{Rarity|Epic}} or below.
*You can only equip one of ''each '' <span style="color:#f074e9;">'''Unique'''</span> Relic to a team at a time. (Ex: You can't have two units with Mirrorblade on the same team.)
*Relics can be unequipped, allowing you to move them from unit to unit, as needed.
*There are currently no {{Rarity|Rare}} or {{Rarity|Secret}} relics.
